title: BV pushforward as a quasi-isomorphism
summary: Given a BV theory on a space of fields split into two subspaces ("infrared" and "ultraviolet"), one has the BV pushforward map $P_*$, sending observables to observables of the effective theory on the infrared space. This note proves that $P_*$ is a quasi-isomorphism of BV complexes, by realizing it as a part of a strong deformation retraction constructed using the homological perturbation lemma. Two proofs are given: (i) comparing Feynman diagrams for $P_*$ with "cable diagrams" arising from homological perturbation theory and (ii) using topological quantum mechanics.
